mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a creature of the earth, gifted with organs of sense to know and perceive."
Humanity is a creature of the earth, gifted with organs of sense to know and perceive.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a similarity between two parts of the same statement or sentence, the first section raising a certain expectation and the second completing it."
A parallelism is a similarity between two parts of the same statement or sentence, the first section raising a certain expectation and the second completing it.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the creator whose works deserve a response of awe and piety on the part of the wise."
Yahweh is the creator whose works deserve a response of awe and piety on the part of the wise.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a single entity of praise, prayers, and spiritual instructions - a total of 150 psalms in our modern Bible versions."
The book is a single entity of praise, prayers, and spiritual instructions - a total of 150 psalms in our modern Bible versions.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a part of Old Testament theology which in turn is part of Biblical Theology."
Wisdom Literature is a part of Old Testament theology which in turn is part of Biblical Theology.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an interesting phenomenon to reflect on intellectually, but only if our theologies do incorporate a notion of God's omnipotence according to which he does anything in logically consistent ways."

Theodicy is an interesting phenomenon to reflect on intellectually, but only if our theologies do incorporate a notion of God's omnipotence according to which he does anything in logically consistent ways.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an antithesis of wisdom (Pr.5,7, 9)."
Sexual immorality is an antithesis of wisdom (Pr.5,7, 9).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the inevitable loss of collective and individual memory (Ecc.1:8-11; 5:20)."
The basis for Qoheleth is the inevitable loss of collective and individual memory (Ecc.1:8-11; 5:20).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means in history to accomplish his purposes, yet such means do not generally involve coercion."
God uses human means in history to accomplish his purposes, yet such means do not generally involve coercion.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a divine gift from God to humans and revealed to them the will and nature of God, though considering God to be mysterious and beyond the limits of human comprehension."
Wisdom is a divine gift from God to humans and revealed to them the will and nature of God, though considering God to be mysterious and beyond the limits of human comprehension.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a product of aesthetic appeal and moral standards which must be maintained through "fear of God and the keeping of his commandments"."
The anthropos is a product of aesthetic appeal and moral standards which must be maintained through "fear of God and the keeping of his commandments".
